name: Blopus — Web Search, Fetch & Images
description: Give your agent the open web: search, read full pages, and search images — from an index Blopus crawls itself, not a reseller of another engine's results. blopus_search (freshness windows, domain filters, topic filters, inline full text) + blopus_images (a dedicated image index, not hero images scraped off web results) + blopus_topics (the filter vocabulary, free) + blopus_fetch (complete page text, 50 URLs per call). Get an API key at blopus.ai

apiKey.title: Blopus API key
apiKey.description: Get one at https://blopus.ai — starts with blp_live_

baseUrl.title: API base URL
baseUrl.description: Blopus API base URL. Defaults to https://api.blopus.ai

blopus_search.summary: Web & news search over an independently crawled index. news_only for events, freshness to bound recency, include_domains/exclude_domains to constrain sources, include_content for inline full text, include_images for hero image URLs, min_words to drop stubs and tag listings, topics/exclude_topics to scope by subject area. Billed per block of 10 — count 1 and count 10 cost the same.

blopus_images.summary: Searches the IMAGE index and returns pictures of the subject, not hero images from articles. Use it for “show me”, “what does X look like”, “find a photo of X”. This is not blopus_search with include_images, which returns whatever image those pages happened to use. Render with caption, not title — title is the raw alt attribute and is junk on roughly a quarter of images. max_syndication caps how many pages an image may appear on (default 30) and suppresses stock photography. Billed per block of 10.

blopus_topics.summary: Lists the subject areas valid for the topics / exclude_topics filters on blopus_search. FREE — costs no credits, because topics match EXACTLY and a wrong guess returns zero results indistinguishable from a real no-match. Call once and reuse the answer. min_docs (default 1000) hides tiny labels; 100000 gives only the largest areas. A topic describes what a PUBLICATION covers, not what an article is about.

blopus_fetch.summary: Complete text of indexed pages. Batch up to 50 URLs in ONE call for the price of one search — always batch rather than looping. Unindexed URLs return in failed_results, not charged.
